Reuters — EXCLUSIVE, confirmed published 1 October 2026, 07:53 GMT (08:53 BST). Dateline WASHINGTON/BRUSSELS/PARIS, Oct 1.
Headline: "EXCLUSIVE: US tells France and Germany to release diesel stocks or face US export ban, sources say"

Article text retrieved via Exa (reuters.com blocks WebFetch):
"The Trump administration has told Germany and France to draw down emergency diesel inventories to help to ease global fuel prices or face a potential US diesel export ban, according to three people close to the discussions."

Quote carried by The Independent from this Reuters story — a US official told Reuters: "It is in Europe's best interest to work with the United States as we pursue multiple pathways to boost the supply of refined products and lower costs for consumers."
